item.description: Reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved substantial progress across many domains, but training an agent \textit{tabula rasa} remains highly sample-inefficient. A common remedy is to initialize the agent using a neural network pretrained on demonstrations.

item.title: NASA’s Webb Shows How Supernova Dust Chronicles Star Evolution
item.description: NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope has painted a vibrant tapestry of the legendary supernova remnant Cassiopeia A (Cas A). Remnants like these are the clouds of gas and dust that remain following the explosion of a massive star and will eventually seed a new generation of stars and planets.

item.title: Improved Digitization Bounds for U(1) Lattice Gauge Theory via Semiclassical Analysis
item.description: Simulating lattice gauge theories on a digital quantum computer or using tensor network methods requires a finite-dimensional approximation of the gauge field, a process often called digitization. Controlling the resulting error is essential for assessing the accuracy and resource requirements of these simulations.

item.description: Quantum reservoir computing (QRC) exploits quantum dynamics for temporal information processing. Quantum noise affects the reservoir dynamics and can either impair computational performance or serve as a computational resource.

item.title: Generalized Wigner-Yanase Uncertainty Bounds for Multiple Quantum Channels
item.description: We derive uncertainty relations for quantum channels based on the generalized Wigner-Yanase skew information. For three channels, we obtain a product lower bound by optimizing over permutations of commutator and anticommutator pairings.

item.title: ProbeAgent: Principled Diagnosis of Agent Failures in Verifiable Environments
item.description: Improving agents requires discovering where they fail and understanding why. An agent acts over multiple steps in a changing environment, so diagnosing its failures requires more than inspecting the final response of a large language model (LLM).

item.title: Multi-Task Self-Evolving Harnesses with the Agent as Its Own Optimizer
item.description: A harness is the code around a language model agent that organizes prompts, calls tools, manages context, and controls execution. As models grow stronger, recent work has begun to let agents improve their own harnesses, a line of work known as self-evolving harnesses.
